title: ParamRepulsor 2D sampling stress-test datasets
group_column: group (evaluation/plotting only; not a training feature)
notes: All 36-point rows appear unchanged in the 50-point and 100-point files; all 50-point rows appear unchanged in the 100-point file.
The 100-point set adds a fourth group, so comparing group preservation across sizes is not a pure controlled change in N.
The two score columns are both in 0–100 units. These are synthetic values, not real student data.
All 10 nearest neighbors by plain Euclidean distance belong to the same cluster at each size. Actual ParamRepulsor NN selection also applies local-distance scaling.
A 36-point set is the cardinality minimum for 1 anchor + 10 unique NN + 5 distinct nonoverlapping MN + 20 distinct FP; additional distance-order constraints are not guaranteed feasible.
No ParamRepulsor training or before/after comparisons have been run yet.
